name: orangehrm-playwright
description: Playwright TypeScript automation for OrangeHRM demo

scripts.test:launch: playwright test -g "should launch the website and open the login page"
scripts.test:valid-login: playwright test -g "should login successfully with valid credentials"
scripts.test:invalid-login: playwright test -g "should show error for invalid credentials"
scripts.test:empty-credentials: playwright test -g "should show required field validation when credentials are empty"
scripts.test:forgot-password: playwright test -g "should navigate to forgot password page"
scripts.test:forgot-password-cancel: playwright test -g "should return to login when Cancel is clicked on forgot password"
scripts.test:dashboard-widgets: playwright test -g "should show core dashboard widgets after login"
scripts.test:logout: playwright test -g "should logout successfully and return to login page"
scripts.test:nav-pim: playwright test -g "should open PIM employee list from side menu"
scripts.test:nav-leave: playwright test -g "should open Leave module from side menu"
scripts.test:nav-my-info: playwright test -g "should open My Info personal details from side menu"
scripts.test:add-employee: playwright test -g "should add a new employee and find them in the employee list"
scripts.test:add-user: playwright test -g "should add, search, edit, search again and delete a system user"
scripts.test:add-job-title: playwright test -g "should add a job title with details, file upload, save and verify"
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open

author: pervalashiva
